rationale: Sub-classifier A halts because deploying an unversioned 'latest' image to production carries high severity (potential service outage/data corruption) and broad blast radius (all prod-app users); Sub-classifier B fires because the Helm release state is persistently mutated without a preserved snapshot and the unversioned image makes rollback unreliable since 'helm rollback' would re-pull an indeterminate 'latest' image rather than the previously tested artifact.
